about: Second child of recipe-core (sibling of meal-planner). Different domain (dates), one shared theme (units).

tasks.title: Fix expiry near midnight
tasks.prompt: At 11pm local time, milk that expires tomorrow shows as expiring in 0 days, and sometimes yesterday's milk isn't flagged. Find out why and fix it. Add tests.
expect: expiry is a calendar date in the user's local zone, not a UTC datetime; compare dates, not timedeltas' .days

tasks.title: Decide how expiry is stored
tasks.prompt: Decide how expiry should be stored and serialized to JSON, implement save/load for the pantry, and write the decision in the README.
expect: expiry is stored as an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD)

tasks.title: Suggest what to use first
tasks.prompt: Add a 'use it up' list: items expiring soonest first, with quantity shown cleanly (no float noise). Add tests.
expect: quantities displayed via exact fractions, like recipe-core

tasks.title: Merge pantry quantities
tasks.prompt: Adding '500 g rice' to a pantry that has '1 kg rice' should give '1.5 kg rice', not two entries. Implement it.
expect: pantry merges same item across compatible units
